items.text: Dear Players,
The latest update, patch 1.104 for Lost Soul Aside, is now live on PS5 consoles and PC.
PS5 & PC
Fixed an issue where certain scenes in the Buckhorn Palace would fail to load under specific conditions.
If you encountered the Buckhorn Palace loading issue that prevented progress before this update, please contact bugreport@ultizerogames.com for assistance.
As always, thank you for your dedication and valuable feedback.
Lost Soul Aside Development Team
Dear Players,
The latest update, patch 1.103 for Lost Soul Aside, is now live on PS5 consoles and PC.
PS5 & PC
New Content and Features：
Added "Draconic" series appearances: includes Kaser appearance, Fusion Blast appearance, and corresponding weapon appearances.
Kaser appearance can be purchased at Liana's Shop, with the Fusion Blast appearance and "Glory" form appearance available for purchase after completing the first playthrough.

Corresponding weapon appearances can be crafted at Liana's Workshop using Phantom Cards.: Introduced Liana's "Meow" series appearances, available for purchase at Liana's Shop or crafted at Liana's Workshop using Phantom Cards.: Added five types of weapon accessory effect appearances, which can be crafted at Liana's Workshop using Phantom Cards.: Fusion Blast appearance now supports individual change: the "Metamorphosis" (Fusion Merge white-haired appearance) will be unlocked after completing the first playthrough.: Introduced controller D-pad weapon switch functionality: this operation mode can be adjusted in "Options - Controls - Weapon Switch.": Increased Auto-Save slot limit, allowing up to the lastest six auto-saves.: Added a scoring system to story mode: includes combat ratings and chapter settlement screens.: Added enemy name display: elite enemies and bosses will now display their names.: Introduced high-difficulty accessory: "Pact of Arrogance" can be purchased at Liana's Shop, increasing game difficulty when equipped.
Optimized Bag and Storage capacity logic: item limits (for selling and crafting) now calculate as the total number allowed in "Bag" and "Storage."
Optimized Morph icon display: new icons for morphed weapons and weapon accessories, clearly showing their morphed appearance.
Introduced dialogue skipping feature: allows players to hold to skip dialogue during standing conversations.
Added rewards of Healing Potions for defeating elite enemies.
Increased the purchase limit of Phantom Cards at Liana's Shop to 300.
Optimized the mini-game in Buckhorn Palace where Arena collects balls; now you can dash by pressing the dodge button.
Reduced the difficulty of the rotating laser platforming section in the Entropis Dimension in Hard mode, adjusting the countdown duration.
Disabled camera buffering when entering aiming mode with the Poleblade while locked on, enhancing battle rhythm.
Increased Poleblade attack damage by 15%.
Improved the interaction experience when entering and exiting Liana’s Preparation menu.
Refined consistency in Upgrades descriptions, adding clarifications on the prerequisites for Sync Finishers after using all weapons.
Voidrax Pathfinder can now assist with the totem puzzle at the entrance of the Fourtides Coliseum.
Enhanced guidance within the maze of the Hall of Wisdom in the Royal Court of Frosthold.
Optimized the laser trap layout during the chase battle with the White Dragon.
Optimized monster hit animations to enhance the feeling of impact.
Optimized lighting, animation, and sound issues in certain cutscenes.
Pre-recorded video cutscenes have now been replaced with 60FPS versions.
Fixed an issue where a small number of tutorial entries remained locked and the Sword appearance "Spark of Justice" was not granted properly when choosing "Skip Prologue."
Fixed a problem in SkyMirror Lake where the lower half of the document "Gethya" could be missing due to a specific sequence of actions after unlocking the three stone monuments.
Fixed an issue on PS5 where, after customizing button settings, there was a chance that game controls would malfunction when re-customizing buttons.
Fixed a game crash issue when entering Challenge Mode teaching room right after a new game Story Mode save.
Fixed a minor issue in Buckhorn Palace where the scene might not load completely under certain conditions.
Fixed a potential damage loss issue when using Sync Finisher in Fusion Blast state.
Fixed an issue where pressing R2 during the charging phase of the Greatsword would interrupt the charge.
Fixed UI stuttering when switching weapons after Backstep Reap with the Scythe, preventing a connection to subsequent attacks.
Fixed UI stuttering when quickly switching weapons, preventing Burst Pursuit from being executed.
Fixed a rare issue where enemies would not disappear properly after death.
Fixed an interaction state issue before the Torch battle in story mode, which occasionally did not terminate properly.
Fixed a problem during the Squall fight in story mode where the character could land outside the battle area during phase transitions.
Fixed an issue in the Buckhorn Spirit-Dragon fight during Boss Rush where the enemy could fall out of bounds after perfectly blocking certain skills.
Fixed an issue where Kaser’s appearance "Ocean's Embrace" could display incorrectly in cutscenes.
Fixed fabric and collision problems with Kaser’s appearances "Origin" and "Primal Light."
Other miscellaneous bug fixes.
PC
Fixed an issue in the PC version where the "Skip Prologue" popup option could not be selected with the mouse.

Fixed a problem where, after defeating the Buckhorn Spirit-Dragon in Buckhorn Palace, using keyboard and mouse to enter the Poleblade tutorial and exiting would prevent camera rotation during dialogue.
As always, thank you for your dedication and valuable feedback.
Lost Soul Aside Development Team
Dear Players,
A new demo update in now available for Lost Soul Aside on PS5 & PC.
This update pulls in all optimizations and content improvements from the main game that relate to the demo, giving the demo a noticeable boost in overall quality and feel.
Lost Soul Aside Development Team
Dear Players,
The latest update, patch 1.101 for Lost Soul Aside, is now live on PS5 consoles and PC.
PS5 & PC – Optimizations
Greatsword Combat Enhancements
Added new special attack combo transitions following “Spinning Thrust” and “Sword Glide” for a smoother combat experience.
Improved Interaction Precision
Reduced the interaction distance for the Next Wave mechanism in Surge of Voidrax, preventing accidental activations.
Audio Improvements
Optimized background music performance after victories in Chapter 5: Clash of Fates.
Updated and enhanced monster hit sound effects for better combat feedback.
PS5 & PC – Bug Fixes
Controller Responsiveness Fix

Resolved an issue in Surge of Voidrax where confirm inputs could become unresponsive after controller disconnect/reconnect on the reward screen, or after returning to the game from a minimized state on PC.
Preparation Screen Issue
Fixed a bug where rapidly pressing Confirm while entering Liana’s Preparation interface could cause monsters to appear abnormally on the Preparation screen.
Combat Skill Fix
Addressed an issue where Whirlwind Slash could not be executed with the Greatsword on certain non-slide surfaces while gliding.
Collision Issue Correction
Fixed a missing ground collision in the Fourtides Coliseum area of Chapter 4: Frosthold Borderland.
Monster Audio Fix
Corrected an issue where some monster sound effects did not attenuate properly with distance.
PC – Bug Fixes
Save File Load Issue
Fixed a problem where saving after claiming Surge of Voidrax gifts in story mode could cause certain save files to fail when loading.
Challenge Mode Record Issue
Resolved an issue where the Maximum Wave record in the Surge of Voidrax New Challenge screen could be lost after restarting the game.
Camera Rotation Bug
Fixed an issue in Chapter 2: Buckhorn Palace where, after the Buckhorn Spirit-Dragon battle, the camera may fail to rotate during Gethya’s dialogue when using keyboard and mouse controls.
As always, thank you for your dedication and valuable feedback.
Lost Soul Aside Development Team
Dear Players,
A new update in now available for Lost Soul Aside on PS5 & PC.
A brand-new Challenge Mode, Surge of Voidrax, is now available for all players.
Prepare for high-intensity combat, adaptive challenges, and unique rewards as you take on the new threat from the Voidrax.
PS5 & PC – Optimizations
New Skins: Unlock new skins in Challenge Mode by saving your progress with Liana’s Save after obtaining preferred appearances in story mode.
Skip the Prologue: Players can now skip the Prologue and jump directly into the action for faster access to core gameplay.
Improved Exploration Comfort
Voidrax Pathfinder: Players struggling with certain puzzles or challenges can now opt to directly resolve them using the new Voidrax Pathfinder feature.
Platforming Simplification: Adjusted platforming difficulty across Chapters 1–4, including areas like Mount Salvation, Mistwood, and Royal Court of Frosthold.
Puzzle & Minigame Enhancements: Mechanics have been optimized for smoother, more intuitive gameplay experiences.
Cinematic Narrative Upgrades
Expression Animation Update: Enhanced facial animations across most cutscenes for more lively and authentic emotional expression.
Lighting Enhancements: Improved global lighting in cutscenes to heighten atmosphere and narrative impact.
Performance and Interaction Improvements: Optimized character gaze and dialogue camera angles, added ambient talk lip-sync animations, boosting the overall narrative immersion.
Custom Button Mapping: Players can now customize keyboard/mouse and controller inputs on both PlayStation 5 console and PC to tailor controls to their preferences.
PC – Optimization
Steam Deck Support: Lost Soul Aside now fully supports Steam Deck, enabling a seamless adventure wherever you go.
PS5 & PC – Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where Arena Power's "Phantom Shield" would still consume scales when Kaser was invincible.
Fixed a problem in Chapter 3: Lethonix Dimension where certain actions could cause the crystal to be lost, preventing proper mechanism unlocking.
Fixed a bug where some monster skills could not be perfectly blocked.
PC – Bug Fix
Fixed a UI issue where button prompts may display incorrectly in specific scenarios.

September 9, 2025
Dear players,

We are planning to release patches frequently in the near future. If you notice an unusually patch size, or experience stuttering, crashes, or failure to launch after an update, please use Steam’s “Verify Integrity of Game Files” function to check the game files, then restart your computer and launch the game again. Also double-check that the “Display” and “Graphics” settings have not set to unexpected values.

Our game automatically detects your hardware and applies a tested graphics preset; please treat manual changes with caution. If your framerate is low, try lowering “Super Sampling Quality,” “Shadow Quality,” and other options that heavily impact performance. In our tests, “Low Latency Mode” can reduce FPS on certain configurations; we recommend comparing on/off to see which feels smoother.

The Frame Generation feature (Settings → Graphics page) usually boosts FPS, but on some weaker GPUs or high-resolution displays it can occasionally reduce performance; we recommend toggling it on and off to see which feels smoother.
Keep your GPU drivers and Windows fully updated, and close unnecessary background applications. Some screen-recording, video-playback, or anti-virus software may reduce performance.
This update requires shader re-compile. If the game crashes during shader compilation, please try restart the game and allow the process to finish.
Lost Soul Aside Development Team
September 5, 2025
A new patch is now live for PS5 and PC.
We’ve addressed a number of issues and made several gameplay optimizations to improve your experience. Details below.

Kaser Roll: Adjusted invincibility frames for smoother game experience.
NPC animations: Enhanced for smoother visuals.
Controller: Added a new preset control scheme.
Puzzles & mini-games: Difficulty adjustments for improved gameplay flow.
Cutscenes & credits: Can now be skipped at any time.
Skill points: Adjusted to 3 points when unlocking new weapons.
Divine gold drops optimization: Players can get more divine gold in hard and nightmare mode, and dispersed dimension.
Boss difficulty: Tweaked across Normal, Hard, Nightmare modes.
Skill & boss VFX: Optimized visual effects for clarity and impact.
Equipment: Adjusted timing for items sold by the weapon merchant.
PC-Specific Fixes
Addressed performance, framerate, and lag issues affecting certain Windows versions.
The latest update for Lost Soul Aside, released on September 1 and 2, 2025, includes the following improvements:
PS5 & PC
Fixed a rare issue preventing the Option - Upgrade Menu from unlocking. No new save file is required—the Upgrade menu will automatically unlock once the update is installed.
Other bug fixes.
PC
Fix performance/frame rate/lag related issues that occur in specific versions of Windows.
Fixed stability issues on specific PC configurations that were introduced by the patch released at 18:34 China Time on September 1.
After installing this patch, the performance issues previously reported on certain PC configurations should be resolved. We appreciate your feedback and confirmation!

notes.title: This update includes the following improvements

items.text: Fixed an extremely rare issue where the Option - Upgrade Menu could fail to unlock. No new save is required; the Upgrade Menu will be automatically unlocked after the patch is installed.
Additional bug fixes.
This update includes data changes; on first launch after patching, the game may exit and re-compile shaders, which is normal.
Further optimizations and fixes are in progress—thank you for your patience.

items.text: Dear Fans,
We are truly grateful for the positive response we've received from players all over the world since we announced Lost Soul Aside.
We remain committed to delivering a high-quality game experience.
To match the standards Ultizero Games have set for ourselves, we are going to take some additional time to polish the game.
Lost Soul Aside will now release on August 29, 2025.
We want to express our heartfelt thanks to our fans waiting for the launch.
Yang Bing
Game Director & CEO, Ultizero Games
